messages:
Maya: anyone else seeing apac-east GPU nodes stuck in provisioning? they spun up but never join the fleet, started ~08:24 UTC :thinking:
Sam: yep, started getting alerts 08:25 — kubelet logs show repeated KMS decrypt errors during node bootstrap:
Sam: ```
Error: failed to decrypt bootstrap-token: AccessDeniedException: Not authorized to decrypt key
	at com.redwood.init.Decryptor.run(Decryptor.java:72)
```
Li: metrics: node-join failure rate ~28% for that region, warm pool draining -> provisioning queue doubling, estimated $6.5k additional ephemeral instance spend last 2h :grimacing:
ops-bot: alert: apac-east: node.join.failure > 20% for 12m — paging eng-platform on-call
Jordan: suspicious — did we just push the new IAM conditional policy for keystore access? that policy added `aws:SourceIp` + VPC endpoint constraint last night
Maya: @Jordan yeah that went out in the firewall/keystore hardening PR at 02:00. ops said it was low-risk because only controlplane subnets were changed
Sam: but bootstrap originates from ephemeral provisioning subnets that use ephemeral NATs, IPs vary. conditional check fails if SourceIp doesn't match expected range
Jordan: and KMS denies would surface as decrypt failures in the bootstrap flow — nodes can't unwrap credentials to register with control plane
Li: quick impact breakdown: join latency up x3 in apac-east, autoscaler spinning up replacements, percent of serving capacity degraded ~12% in that region. if this persists cost +latency both up
Maya: immediate ask: can we add an allowlist exception for the provisioning NAT range while we fix the policy?
security-bot: suggested remediation: temporary keystore policy exception OR attach role-based trust to the bootstrap role. Must preserve audit trail. Recommend adding a short-lived condition bypass with explicit reason tag and 1h TTL
Jordan: I can patch the policy to include the nat-eph CIDR ranges used by warmpool (quick patch):
Jordan: ```aws iam put-policy --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::111222333:policy/keystore-read --policy-document file://keystore-policy-patch.json```
Jordan: patch content snippet: `{ "Condition": { "IpAddress": { "aws:SourceIp": ["54.12.34.0/24","54.12.35.0/24"]] } }`
Sam: before we do that, quick mitigation we executed: 1) paused autoscaler, 2) disabled warmpool eviction so existing nodes stay, 3) allowed those failing nodes to reattempt join via manual restart of init container — some recovered
Maya: thumbs — good. we still need a guarded rollback if patch fails. ops on-call: can you annotate the change in the audit workspace and post the policy diff?
Li: cost estimate if we leave things 4h: ~ $18k extra. if we fix in next 30m cost delta drops to ~ $1.2k.
Jordan: doing the patch now, will add explicit `kms:ViaService` and the nat CIDRs as exception, and set a 1h expiry via org-automation to revert
security-bot: note: create a linked audit runbook entry and tag the policy change with `incident:apac-keystore-2026-03-22` for compliance. Also run a quick eval to ensure we didn't open broader egress risk
Maya: after patch, verify node join rates and kubelet logs. Sam, Li, can you watch the provisioning queue and alert me in 10m?
Sam: watching now. logs show a partial uptick in decrypt success within 3m of the patch (if applied).
ops-bot: deploy-bot: policy update applied to staging at 08:38 UTC
Sam: update: join failure rate fell to 6% after patch, warmpool reusing nodes, autoscaler resuming safely
Li: tracking: provisioning queue back to baseline in 14m, cost projection normalized
Jordan: follow-ups: 1) revert temporary exception (automation in 1h) 2) design change: replace SourceIp conditional with VPC principal condition (more stable) 3) add canary test: simulate bootstrap decrypt in staging across ephemeral NATs each change
Maya: agree. draft the policy rewrite and a staged rollout plan. schedule sync with security next hour to approve the VPC principal approach
security-bot: acknowledged — will set meeting and prepare audit note template
Maya: ok closing the thread for live ops — create a short postmortem entry with timeline and cost numbers, assign owners for policy rewrite and canary. thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
